attributes.magic: PE32+ executable (console) x86-64, for MS Windows

crowdsourced_ai_results.analysis: The analyzed binary is the legitimate Microsoft Windows Active Directory Preparation utility (adprep.exe). It is used by administrators to prepare an Active Directory forest and its domains for domain controller upgrades. The decompilation reveals standard administrative behaviors, including command-line argument parsing for forest and domain preparation (/ForestPrep, /DomainPrep, /rodcPrep), usage of the DsGetDcNameW API for Domain Controller discovery, and the creation of the 'Global\ADPREP is running' mutex to prevent concurrent executions. There are no indications of malicious activity or obfuscation.
